Counsel for Applicant :- Narendra Gupta Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Anurag Singh Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.

2. In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that the informant was married to one Israj for the last 20 years it was stated that sufficient dowry was given, however, constant demand of dowry was being made by the entire matrimonial family.
It was also stated that the informant and Israj have five children out of their matrimonial alliance.
The allegations were made against the entire matrimonial family of harassing the informant.
It was also alleged that her husband was having a extra marital affair as against the applicant, who is nephew of Israj.

It was stated that he tried to misbehave with her,
subsequently in the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C, the allegation of rape was also leveled Ateek Ahmad vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home Civil ...

1 against the applicant.
3. Learned A.G.A. opposed the bail prayer.

4.On the plain reading of the FIR and the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C., it is clear that general allegations were leveled against the entire family members and scandalous allegations were leveled against the applicant, which are also in variance in terms of the allegations in the FIR as well as in the the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. without there being any corroboration or even disclosure of time and place of the incident in view thereof, a case for bail is made out, particularly the applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 02.10.2023.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

5. Let the applicant Ateek Ahmad be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No. 21 of 2023, under Section 376 IPC, Police Station Mahila Thana, District Sitapur, on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
